resources.string: Simmer the rice in water until tender, then drain.
Warm the chickpeas in a skillet until golden. Halve the tomatoes.
Layer the rice, chickpeas, and tomatoes in a bowl. Serve warm.
Rinse the spinach and chickpeas. Halve the tomatoes.
Toss everything together and finish with freshly squeezed lemon.
Fold the spinach and tomatoes into the cooked rice until the spinach wilts.
So good for a quick lunch. I warmed the chickpeas first!
